title: OccupancyGrid geometry
keywords: occupancygrid occupancy grid map cell cells resolution origin width height index row-major unknown shifted yaml
text: info.resolution is metres per cell, info.width and info.height are counts of cells, and info.origin is the real-world pose of cell (0, 0), the lower-left cell of the map image, in the map frame. data is row-major starting at (0, 0): cell (x, y) is data[x + y * width], and with an unrotated origin a point (px, py) falls in cell ((px - origin.x) / resolution, (py - origin.y) / resolution). Values are occupancy probabilities from 0 to 100, and -1 means unknown. A map that appears shifted or rotated usually has a wrong origin in its YAML file.
